name: Save prompt
summary: Bookmark pill that gets tapped, fills in and switches its label to Saved; for save calls to action.

params.name: clickAt
params.note: frame of the tap, after at

params.name: color
params.note: fill colour once saved; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at
